text:
ravi: fyi customer 'nova-pay' reported mass 403s on SCIM and intermittent SAML failures after we applied the Okta attribute rename and scheduled cert rotation. anyone see correlation?
nina: I'm looking. which env? nova-pay-prod. I see a spike in 403s from scim-proxy starting 2026-03-21T02:05:12Z.
carlos: grabbing logs. `kubectl -n identity logs scim-proxy-0 --since=30m | sed -n '1,200p'` shows a lot of `403 Forbidden tenant=nova-pay reason=invalid-signature` and some `403 audit: missing-request-id` lines.

ravi: weird - invalid-signature usually points to SP/IdP cert mismatch or JWK rotation not propagated. we rotated idp_jwks yesterday morning. did the metadata push to onboarding-service succeed?
nina: onboarding-service reports push success for tenant:nova-pay but the cert thumbprint in the tenant record is still the old one. looks like a write race. journal shows: 
```
2026-03-21T02:03:01Z onboarding INFO push-jwks tenant=nova-pay status=accepted tx=tx_9a7
2026-03-21T02:03:01Z onboarding WARN tenant-update-delayed tenant=nova-pay reason=db-write-timeout
2026-03-21T02:05:10Z scim-proxy ERROR saml: signature_verification_failed tenant=nova-pay issuer=okta
```
so the push was accepted but DB write didn't complete, yet services read new jwks from cache layer. inconsistency.
carlos: also found this in auth-gateway: `saml: assertion size=5130 headers_len=8192` then downstream 403 because header truncated and signature field got chopped. some gateways treat missing signature as invalid.

ravi: ugh, two issues colliding: jwks write race + assertion/header truncation. customer sees 403s and some users can't login. immediate mitigations?
nina: short-term: 1) pause the automated attribute rename for nova-pay (it's a feature-flag flip) 2) force a full metadata re-push and block reads until DB write confirms (we can use onboarding-service's sequencer) 3) have scim-proxy trim SAML header payloads to safe maxLen and reject oversized assertions with a 429 so downstream doesn't mis-interpret truncated signatures.
carlos: I'll open an emergency PR to auth-gateway to cutoff headers > 6KB and return 413 to the IdP so we get a clearer signal. will also add a temporary compress (gzip) negotiation for group attributes on the SAML assertion.
ops-bot: runbook step executed: feature-flag nova-pay attr-rename -> paused by nina

security-bot: vuln-triage: marking as medium — large assertions leading to header truncation could be used for request smuggling or signature strip attacks. recommend infra-security run fuzz tests on our gateway parsing for next week.
ravi: thanks. action owners: nina -> metadata re-push + sequencer gating, carlos -> gateway header cap + compress fallback, ops -> monitor SCIM 429/403 rate and rollback flag if errors increase, me -> customer comms + postmortem.
nina: re-push initiated, waiting on DB durable write. will not unpause reads until tx confirmed.
carlos: PR opened: `auth-gateway: header-limit-6k, assertion-compress-fallback` link: https://git.internal/r/auth-gateway/pull/3254 (deploy gated)
ops-bot: monitor: scim 403s dropped from 220/min -> 18/min after gating reads (1m window).
ravi: good. let's not forget re-running the KMS key-check for tenant secrets — we rotated tenant-level KMS keys last week and onboarding-service uses KMS to unwrap jwks during push. if unwrap fails we might have shadow state. nina pls verify KMS unwraps succeeded for nova-pay tx_9a7.
nina: ran `kmsctl unwrap --tenant nova-pay --tx tx_9a7` returned success for 98% keys, 2% had `AccessDenied` due to IAM role not propagated to new kms key policy. i'm retrying unwraps with exponential backoff.
security-bot: note: add to postmortem: 1) race between jwks write+cache read 2) assertion size causing header truncation 3) KMS IAM propagation delay 4) attribute rename timing amplified group count. recommended remediations: writable sequencer for metadata pushes, assertion size guardrails + compression, KMS propagation checks in rotation playbook.
ravi: OK. set followups: - postmortem owner nina - infra-security to run header-parsing fuzz (carlos to coordinate) - ops to build alert for `saml: assertion size > 4k`
ops-bot: alert created: saml.assertion.size > 4096 for 5m -> paging oncall
nina: confirming DB tx durable write completed, re-enabled reads for nova-pay, resuming attr-rename when gateway PR is live.
carlos: deployed header-cap to canary, no regressions so far.
ravi: closing this thread, will file incident report and link to vuln-triage ticket. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
